blocks.title: Three jobs we take off your desk
blocks.intro: Each one is set up once, written down and handed over. Pick one or all three.

items.title: Scheduling that holds
items.text: One shared calendar, clear rules for changes, and a weekly check so double bookings stop before they start.

items.title: Invoicing that gets paid
items.text: Templates, reminders and a Friday routine that turns finished work into sent invoices.

items.title: Handover that sticks
items.text: Written routines for the tasks only one person knows, so a holiday no longer stops the team.

blocks.title: We stay until it runs without us
blocks.body:
Most advice ends with a document. Ours ends with a team that no longer needs us.

We work inside your tools, in your calendar and your inbox, so the routines are the ones you will actually use.

pages.title: About Halden & Co
pages.description: Halden & Co is a two person studio that fixes scheduling, invoicing and handover for small teams. Meet the people who do the work.

blocks.headline: Two people who like a tidy inbox
blocks.subhead: Halden & Co is a small studio. We started it after ten years of running operations for other people's teams.

blocks.title: How we started
blocks.body:
Halden & Co began in 2019, when Hannah Halden left an events company and found that three of her former clients still phoned her to ask how things worked.

That told us something. The knowledge lived in one head, and the head had left the building. Our whole method is a reaction to that.

### What we believe

- Write it down, in plain words, where the team can find it.
- Fix the routine that costs the most time first.
- If a client needs us forever, we did the job badly.

blocks.title: Who you will work with
blocks.body:
Hannah Halden and Sam Oduya do the work themselves. There is no team of juniors behind us.

Hannah leads scheduling and handover. Sam leads invoicing and the numbers.
